name: blueprint/invoice-tracker
description: Invoices with teeth: extract vendor/amount/due, store the record, schedule a reminder event at the due date, deliver through the reminder flow
recipe: extract the fields from the invoice text -> store the invoice record -> schedule a due-date event -> the due check delivers and marks notified; cancel the event when paid
pitfalls: a due-date parse failure is a clean error - recheck the invoice, never half-store
cancel the event when paid - two halves, both closed
amounts as numbers, dates as ISO strings
